_doc: Deterministic fast paths (intents.go). Patterns are full-match, case-insensitive, run on the request with accents, trailing punctuation and polite words removed. {{test}} {{build}} {{lint}} {{fmt}} come from project detection, {{git}} is 'git' inside a repository, {{search}} is rg or grep; an empty variable means the intent does not apply. {{slot}} is a named group, checked against slots[slot] and shell-quoted. Override in ~/.config/jazz-cli/intents.json or .jazz/intents.json (same name replaces, "disabled": true removes).

intents.name: test
patterns: (?:rode|roda|rodar|rode ai|roda ai|execute|executa|executar|run|rerun|re-run)(?: (?:os|todos os|the|all|all the))? (?:testes|teste|tests|test|test suite|suite de testes|a suite de testes)(?: (?:de novo|novamente|again|agora|now))?

intents.name: git_status
patterns: git status|git st|status|status do git|status do repo|status do repositorio
(?:mostra|mostre|me mostra|ver|show|show me)(?: o| the)? (?:git )?status(?: do git| do repo| do repositorio)?
qual (?:o|e o) status(?: do git| do repo| do repositorio)?

intents.name: diff
patterns: o que (?:mudou|eu mudei|foi alterado|foi modificado|mudou ate agora|esta diferente|ta diferente)|oque mudou|que mudou|o que mudou no repo|o que mudou no projeto
what changed|what did i change|what(?:'s| has) changed(?: so far)?
(?:mostra|mostre|me mostra|show|show me)(?: o| the| me o)? diff|git diff|diff

intents.name: log
patterns: (?:os )?ultimos commits|git log|recent commits|(?:the )?last commits|historico(?: de commits| do git)?

intents.name: where
patterns: (?:onde (?:esta|fica|ta|e definid[oa]|foi definid[oa]|esta definid[oa])|where is|where's|where are|where is defined) (?:o |a |os |as |the )?(?:funcao |function |func |metodo |method |classe |class |tipo |type |struct |interface |simbolo |symbol |variavel |variable |constante |constant )?(?P<sym>[A-Za-z_$][\w$.]*)(?:\(\))?(?: (?:definid[oa]|defined))?
